szenen.text: Part two. Wednesday: pending home sales at 10 Eastern, and the Fed meeting minutes at 2 pm Eastern. They show how many officials want to hike.
Thursday: the Philly Fed survey, the first look at November factories.
Friday: Michigan consumer sentiment and inflation expectations, both at 10 Eastern. The Fed watches expectations closely.
And all week: fifteen Fed speaker events. Every speech can move rate odds, and crypto with them. Follow for the live reactions.
